topic.title: Cold Plate Thickness for all-core Transient Performance

fig.title: Cold Plate Thickness Example: 15W TDP Package, ACT

body.p: Improving cold plate thickness will result in improvements on short duration (3-5s) turbo power (PL2) despite marginal to negligible improvements to S.S.

Nomenclature:
Power Capability: Additional power the processor can support before reaching maximum operating temperature
S.S. : Steady State
ACT: All-Core-Turbo

note.p: 1 Assumes thicker cold plate does not contribute to higher skin hot spot temperatures
2 It may be difficult to achieve a low bond line thickness (BLT) with 0.25mm cold plates, and that complexity is not comprehended in this sensitivity study.
